title: Meetings
description: Elysium reads your recorded meetings as you, cuts each into its topics, and puts every topic on the timeline of the projects it is about, with its clip, transcript, and summary.

fireflies.title: Fireflies
fireflies.connected: Reading your Fireflies meetings. New ones arrive within ten minutes of Fireflies finishing them.
fireflies.offer: Connect your Fireflies account with your own API key. Nothing is installed into your organization.
fireflies.disconnectedToast: Fireflies is disconnected. Its meetings stay on your timeline.
fireflies.connectedToast: Fireflies is connected. Your meetings from the last two weeks are on their way.

form.heading: Connect Fireflies
form.apiKeyHint: Fireflies, Settings, Developer settings: copy your API key. Elysium checks it with Fireflies before saving it, and never shows it again.
form.storageLocationHint: Recordings and their clips are saved here. Add a location under Settings, Storage first.
form.noStorageLocations: No storage location yet. Add one under Settings, Storage, then come back.
